tips.welcomeDesc: Take a moment to learn about FunctionFly's multi-provider deployment and automatic failover features.
tips.adminPrivileges: You can manage providers, deploy functions, and invite team members.
tips.memberAccess: You can deploy functions and access shared resources.
tips.viewerAccess: You have read-only access to team functions and metrics.
tips.connectProviderDesc: You're about to connect your first cloud provider. This allows FunctionFly to deploy functions across multiple providers for high availability.
tips.deployFunctionDesc: Excellent! Your provider is connected. Now let's deploy your first function to see FunctionFly in action.
tips.tokenSecure: API token securely stored and encrypted
tips.testFailoverDesc: Your function is live! The final step tests your failover setup to ensure high availability.
tips.autoFailover: FunctionFly automatically routes traffic to healthy providers if one fails
tips.teamSetupDesc: Great! Your failover setup is working. Now let's set up your team for collaboration.
tips.inviteTeam: Invite team members to collaborate on functions and share provider access
tips.setupCompleteDesc: Excellent! Your FunctionFly setup is complete and ready for production.
tips.productionReady: You're all set to start deploying functions with high availability!
tips.allCompleteDesc: Congratulations! Your FunctionFly setup is complete and production-ready.
tips.multiProviderDeployed: Your functions are now deployed across multiple providers with automatic failover

warnings.noFunction: You won't deploy your first function to test the setup
warnings.noFailoverTest: You won't test automatic failover capabilities

hints.inviteLater: You can still invite team members later from your dashboard
hints.canResume: You can resume onboarding anytime from your dashboard settings
hints.basicDeploy: Basic functions can still be deployed, but without multi-provider benefits

completion.title: Welcome to FunctionFly!
completion.subtitle: Your setup is complete and production-ready

helloWorld.name: Hello World
helloWorld.description: A simple function that returns a greeting

apiEcho.name: API Echo
apiEcho.description: Echoes back request information as JSON

tabs.sampleFunctionsTooltip: Choose from pre-built function examples to get started quickly. These demonstrate common patterns and are ready to deploy.
tabs.customCodeTooltip: Write your own function code from scratch. Advanced users can deploy custom logic, APIs, or integrations.

deploy.functionEdgeHelp: Edge functions run close to your users worldwide, reducing latency and improving performance compared to traditional server-based functions.
deploy.customCodeNotice: You can deploy your own custom function code. For now, select one of our sample functions to continue with the onboarding.
deploy.functionNameTooltip: Choose a unique name for your function. This will become part of your function's URL (e.g., my-function.functionfly.app).
deploy.urlSuggestionsHint: Click a suggestion to use it as your function name
deploy.functionNameHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. This will be used to generate your function URL.

deployed.title: Function Deployed!
deployed.subtitle: Your function is now live and ready to handle requests.

errors.nameTooShort: Function name must be at least 2 characters
errors.nameTooLong: Function name must be 52 characters or less
errors.nameInvalidChars: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
errors.generic: Deployment failed due to an unexpected error. Please try again.
errors.alternativeDesc: You can also deploy this function later from your dashboard, or try a different function name if the current one is already taken.

advanced.title: Advanced Configuration
advanced.tooltip: Configure environment variables, scaling settings, and other advanced options for your function.
advanced.envVarsTooltip: Add environment variables to configure your function at runtime. These are securely stored and encrypted.
advanced.envVarsHint: Common variables: API keys, database URLs, configuration settings
advanced.scalingTooltip: Control how your function scales with traffic. Higher limits handle more concurrent requests.
advanced.proTipDesc: You can update these settings anytime from your function dashboard. Advanced configurations take effect on the next deployment.

connectProvider.providerReady: Your provider is now ready to deploy functions.
connectProvider.costBasedOn: Based on 1,000 requests/day, 100ms compute time, 128MB memory
connectProvider.apiTokenTooltip: An API token is a secure key that allows FunctionFly to deploy functions to your provider account. You can generate this in your provider's dashboard under API settings.
connectProvider.apiTokenFind: Find your API token in {{name}}'s dashboard under API settings.
connectProvider.apiTokenSecure: Your API token is securely encrypted and stored. We never share your credentials.
connectProvider.shareWithTeamDesc: Allow team members to use this provider for deployments
connectProvider.stillAvailable: You can still get started with the {{count}} available provider

errors.connectionFailed: Failed to connect provider. Please check your API token and try again.
errors.tokenSuggestion: Please check your API token in {{name}} dashboard and ensure it has the correct permissions
errors.networkError: Unable to connect to {{name}} API. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.shareFailed: Provider connected but could not be shared with team
errors.noTeamFound: Provider connected but no team found to share with yet.

toast.shareFailed: Provider connected but could not be shared with team

testFailover.title: Test Failover
testFailover.description: Test your failover setup by simulating a provider failure. We'll verify that traffic automatically routes to your backup.
testFailover.tooltip: Failover ensures your functions stay online even if one provider experiences issues. FunctionFly automatically routes traffic to healthy backup providers.
testFailover.primaryHelp: Your primary provider handles all traffic under normal conditions. It's the first choice for serving your functions.
testFailover.backupHelp: Your backup provider automatically takes over if the primary fails. This ensures your functions stay available 24/7.

steps.detectingDesc: Waiting for automatic failover to trigger
steps.verifyingDesc: Confirming request handled by backup provider

results.title: Test Results
results.passedDesc: Your setup is working correctly. Automatic failover is ready.
results.failedDesc: There was an issue with your failover configuration.
results.whatHappenedDesc: When the primary provider (Cloudflare) was temporarily unavailable, FunctionFly automatically routed traffic to your backup provider (Vercel) with zero downtime.

errors.testFailed: Failover test failed due to an unexpected error.
errors.suggestion: Please check your provider connections and try again.

testFailover.latencyHelp: Latency measures response time. Lower values mean faster performance for your users.

teamSetup.teamBenefitsDesc: Invite team members to collaborate on functions, share provider configurations, and manage deployments together. You can always add members later from your dashboard.
